purpose: Review the importance and learner-facing priority of the 131 canonical Skill Taxonomy v2 families without using authored question counts as a proxy for importance.

current_project_facts.note: Coverage counts are context only. They must not be converted into importance or priority scores.

priority_axes.curriculum_role: Use S1/KNTT and the existing layer boundary. KNTT-Core remains required; optional layers must not gate Core.
priority_axes.foundation_importance: Judge prerequisite/dependency value from curriculum progression and reviewed graph evidence. Graph degree is a signal, not a complete centrality score.
priority_axes.learner_priority: How prominently the family should be surfaced/recommended for ordinary self-study, foundation repair, or entrance preparation.
priority_axes.exam_non_specialist: Use only the declared official Hanoi non-specialized Grade-10 entrance seed (2024-2026) for observed sample statements.
priority_axes.specialist_exam: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE in this packet unless a separate verified specialist corpus is added.
priority_axes.practice_weight_guidance: Recommend relative emphasis only after considering curriculum role, foundation value, transfer value, and verified assessment evidence. Never infer it from current authored question count.
